name: Cherry on Top
concept: The signature line made visual: a confident wine-red brand world with blush pink, a cherry motif and friendly luxury.
signature: 'you, with the cherry on top' as the giant centred hero line with a small drawn cherry mark
cherry mark reused as list bullets and section dividers
blush cards on wine-red for each treatment category
imagery: bold colour-blocked still lifes in reds and blush; cherries, silk, petals; warm studio light
why: Turns her signature line into a memorable brand that feels friendly, never stiff.
